name: Who Said That?
description: Answer silly prompts, then guess who wrote what.

steps: A prompt appears on the TV. Write your answer on your phone. Nobody sees who wrote what.
Then each answer is shown. Guess who wrote it by tapping a name. You never vote on your own.
Tap the laugh button on answers you love.
Don't want to answer a prompt? Tap Pass. The host can hide an answer that isn't suitable.
rules.scoring: Guess the right writer: 100 points. Fool someone with your answer: 50 points each. Every laugh you get: 10 points.
